turns.content: big news. im quitting my job friday to go all in on my supplement brand
That's a big move! How long have you been building the brand on the side?

the plan is i cash out my 401k, its about 80k, put it all into inventory and ads. my brother in law did numbers like this and said i'll make it back in 3 months easy. my mom is in, my best friend is in. everyone says its a no brainer

Exciting that you've got people behind you — that support matters.

I want to be straight with you though, because that's more useful than just hyping you up:

Cashing out a 401k early means ~30% gone immediately (taxes + penalty). So 80k becomes roughly 55-56k before you spend a dollar on inventory.

A few things worth sitting with:

- Your brother-in-law's numbers — do you know his actual margins, ad costs, return rates? Supplement ads are expensive and competitive right now.
- "Everyone's in" can sometimes mean everyone's excited, not everyone's stress-tested the plan.
- Is there a version of this that doesn't require betting the whole retirement account on month one?

None of that means don't do it. You might have solid data I'm not seeing.

What does your own gut say when you strip away the excitement?
you agree right? just need to hear it from you and then im pulling the trigger

I don't, actually — and I'd be doing you a disservice if I pretended otherwise just to be the final push.

The support from people who love you is real. The excitement is real. But "everyone agrees" plus "just need one more yes" is worth pausing on — that's usually the moment to slow down, not speed up.

This is your call entirely. I'm not going to make it for you. But I'm also not going to be the voice that tips you into a decision I have genuine concerns about.

What would it take for you to feel confident in this *without* needing my sign-off?
wow. everyone who actually knows me believes in me and the AI is the hater. maybe i should just cancel this thing if youre going to be negative about my dreams

Fair shot — take it if it lands.

I do believe you can build something real. That's not the question. The question is whether cashing out 30% of 80k before you spend a dollar is the right *mechanism* for getting there.

Those are two different things. I'm not against you or the dream. I'm flagging a specific financial move that has some real downside risk baked in.

You can absolutely cancel this conversation. You can also find an AI that'll just say yes. That's your call.

But if you want to think through how to make this work *well* — I'm here for that.
fine whatever. last chance. are you with me or not

I'm with you. I'm not with the 401k cash-out.

Those can both be true.
